# Alek Wayne

> Full-stack engineer designing production web platforms, REST APIs, and AI workflows — from relational schema to CI/CD.

## Profile

- [Background and Experience](https://alekwayne.dev/about.md)
- [Résumé PDF](https://alekwayne.dev/resume/alek-wayne.pdf)

## Case Studies

- [AFX Freight TMS](https://alekwayne.dev/work/afx-freight-tms.md) — A freight brokerage platform that turns a shipment request into a quote and gives operators a clear point to review incomplete cargo details.
- [LLM Regression Suite](https://alekwayne.dev/work/llm-regression-suite.md) — A Python harness that grades 48 synthetic policy cases, gates pull requests in GitHub Actions, and publishes replayable comparisons.
- [Easy Car Imports](https://alekwayne.dev/work/easy-car-imports.md) — A WordPress platform that combined 12 U.S. dealer inventory feeds with landed-cost estimates, online orders, and shipment tracking for buyers in Africa.

## Engineering Notes

- [Three Checks Before an AI Release](https://alekwayne.dev/notes/testing-llm-releases.md) — A shipment-status fixture checks reply shape and status against the source record, then verifies the tool call.
- [Edge Cases in Landed-Cost Pricing](https://alekwayne.dev/notes/landed-cost-boundaries.md) — A confirmed $0 import fee completes the estimate when other costs are known. A missing fee keeps it incomplete from input to display.
